title: KU Spotlight on Faculty Excellence honorees announced for the 2026-27 year
summary_en: The University of Kansas has announced the 12 faculty members selected for its 2026-27 Spotlight on Faculty Excellence program, which recognizes outstanding achievements in research, scholarship and creative activity across KU’s Lawrence, Edwards and Medical Center campuses.
title_cn: KU Spotlight on Faculty Excellence honorees announced for the 2026-27 year

title: NSF awards $2 million grant to KU-led project supporting future AI and computing leaders
summary_en: A University of Kansas-led initiative has received a $2 million award from the National Science Foundation’s Scholarships in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (S-STEM) program to expand educational opportunities for low-income students pursuing careers in computing, engineering and emerging technology fields.
title_cn: NSF awards $2 million grant to KU-led project supporting future AI and computing leaders

title: $1.5 million NSF grant will support KU research modeling molecular systems using AI
summary_en: University of Kansas researcher Ilya Vakser and colleagues at Stony Brook University and the Stowers Institute for Medical Research will use a three-year grant from the National Science Foundation to expand knowledge of macromolecular systems using artificial intelligence.
title_cn: $1.5 million NSF grant will support KU research modeling molecular systems using AI

title: Luciano Tosta selected for KU’s Woodyard International Educator Award
summary_en: Luciano Tosta, University of Kansas faculty member and director of the Center for Global & International Studies, has earned KU’s top honor in international education for his transformative work across global teaching, research, partnerships and study abroad. KU will celebrate his achievements and hear remarks from Tosta on Oct. 8.
title_cn: Luciano Tosta selected for KU’s Woodyard International Educator Award

title: KU Dining kicks off the 2026-2027 academic school year with updated menus, specials
summary_en: Jayhawks and visitors on the Lawrence campus will see new menu items at Asian Kitchen in The Underground, located in Wescoe Hall. KU Dining will also offer weekly specials including Macchiato Monday and Taco Tuesday at various locations. Special, limited-time menu items are available until Sept. 25.
title_cn: KU Dining kicks off the 2026-2027 academic school year with updated menus, specials
